summary_en: 500,000 shares (0.94% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥1.0B upper limit, market purchase via TSE, Aug 6, 2026 – Aug 5, 2027, to support capital-efficiency and shareholder-value objectives under new three-year business plan; acquisition not mandatory.
title_en: Notice of Share Acquisition Authorization Framework Setting
translation_en_brief: On August 5, 2026, the board of Fuji Kyuko Co., Ltd. authorized a framework for acquiring up to 500,000 common shares of the company (0.94% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an aggregate maximum of ¥1.0 billion. The acquisition period runs from August 6, 2026 through August 5, 2027. The method is open-market purchase via the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The company states that the repurchase is intended to support capital efficiency and shareholder-value objectives within its new three-year business plan (fiscal 2026–2028) and cash-allocation policy. The authorization is discretionary; partial or full non-execution is possible depending on market conditions and investment opportunities. As of June 30, 2026, the company held 1,534,670 treasury shares against 53,350,068 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
